rows.note: Use 等於 as the all-purpose verb when something has the same value or amounts to the same consequence.

example.english: Five kilograms equal five thousand grams.
example.jyutping: ng5 gung1 gan1 dang2 jyu1 ng5 cin1 hak1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for things that are the same, practically interchangeable, or ordinarily exactly the same.

example.english: These two phones are equal for practical purposes, so either one will do.
example.traditional: 呢兩部電話功能一樣，邊部都得。
example.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 bou6 din6 waa6 gung1 nang4 jat1 joeng6 bin1 bou6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person or thing at the same rank or level.

example.english: He is my equal, so I don't need to be especially deferential to him.
example.traditional: 佢係我嘅同級，唔使對佢特別客氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tung4 kap1 m4 sai2 deoi3 keoi5 dak6 bit6 haak3 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person of the same generation, standing, or social group.

example.english: I’m usually less formal when chatting with people of my generation, each of whom is my equal in age and status.
example.traditional: 我同啲同輩傾計，通常冇咁拘謹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 di1 tung4 bui3 king1 gai2 tung1 soeng4 mou5 gam3 keoi1 gan2

rows.note: Use this when the equal is a rival or competitor rather than merely someone of equal status.

example.english: That team is our equal on the pitch, so the match was tough.
example.traditional: 嗰隊係我哋場上嘅對手，實力唔相伯仲。
example.jyutping: go2 deoi6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 deoi3 sau2 sat6 lik6 m4 soeng1 baak3 zung6

rows.traditional: 將 A 整到同 B 一樣
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A zing2 dou3 tung4 B jat1 joeng6
rows.note: Use this construction when describing making one thing match another in level, amount, or quality.

example.english: I’ll make the volume equal to yours.
example.traditional: 我將個音量整到同你一樣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 go3 jam1 loeng6 zing2 dou3 tung4 nei5 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically for equal status, rights, opportunities, or treatment.

example.traditional: 人人都應該得到平等對待。
example.jyutping: jan4 jan4 dou1 jing1 goi1 dak1 dou2 ping4 dang2 deoi3 doi6

rows.note: Use this for equal numerical or geometric values, especially in mathematical or formal contexts.

example.english: Three plus two is equal to five.
example.jyutping: saam1 gaa1 ji6 soeng1 dang2 jyu1 ng5

rows.note: Use 比得上 when someone or something matches another in ability, quality, or performance.

example.english: This new phone can equal a flagship model.
example.traditional: 呢部新電話真係比得上旗艦機。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 bei2 dak1 soeng5 kei4 laam6 gei1

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective when someone or something is capable enough to handle a task.

example.english: They are equal to the task of handling the whole report on their own.
example.traditional: 佢一個人搞掂成份報告，真係夠掂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 dim6 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 gau3 dim6
